thread: Round 2: thank you, the window has closed
subject: Round 2: thank you, the window has closed
body:
Hello,

Thank you to everyone who sent in an application. The window closed last night and the review has started. You do not need to do anything for now. When we have something to tell you, you will hear from us by email, and the call page remains the place for anything about the call itself.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Monday: what the weekend looked like
subject: Monday: what the weekend looked like
body: Karin, the contact mailbox had 27 messages over the weekend. Most were thank-yous and a few were about spelling of company names in the confirmation emails. I answered the easy ones and left six for you, tagged red.

thread: Monday: what the weekend looked like
subject: Re: Monday: what the weekend looked like
body: Thanks. I will take the six after lunch. Please do not forward anything about individual applications to the mentors, I want the review to stay clean.

subject: February close and a variance
body: Karin, February is closed. Demo day cost 61 800 SEK, which is 3 200 below the number I gave you in January. The saving is the catering. I will put the leftover in the line for the thank-you evening.

subject: Invoice 4502 and reprint
body: Hi Sofia, invoice 4502 covers the demo day posters and the tote bags, 5 880 SEK including VAT. The reprint of the signage you asked for was received after the deadline for this month's invoicing, so it will appear on the March invoice instead. No change in price.

subject: Fwd: Invoice 4502 and reprint
body: Anders, invoice 4502 for the posters and bags. Please pay from marketing. The reprint appears in March.

subject: Call page: Estonian diacritics
body: Hi all, the Estonian placenames on the call page lost their dots over the vowels in the last edit. I fixed the encoding so Tõnismägi and Pärnu look right. That is all that changed.

subject: Re: Call page: Estonian diacritics
body: Thanks, Mari would have noticed instantly and would have been too kind to say so.

thread: Mentor sessions in March: three conflicts
subject: Mentor sessions in March: three conflicts
body: Daniel, there are three clashes in the March assignments. Oskar has two sessions at the same hour on the 12th, Liis is double booked on the 17th, and Mari's session on the 19th falls on a public holiday in Estonia. Can you rebuild those three before I send the March schedule?

thread: Mentor sessions in March: three conflicts
subject: Re: Mentor sessions in March: three conflicts
body: Rebuilt. Oskar's second session moved to the 19th, Liis's to the morning of the 18th, and Mari's to Friday the 20th. I wrote to all three startups and put the changes in the sheet.

thread: Mentor fee adjustment for travelling mentors
subject: Mentor fee adjustment for travelling mentors
body: Nora, a question about the fee adjustment you mentioned in the autumn. If I travel from Gothenburg for a Monday session, is the train still covered or is it the old flat sum? I would rather not be out of pocket but I also do not want to cause admin.

thread: Mentor fee adjustment for travelling mentors
subject: Re: Mentor fee adjustment for travelling mentors
body: The train is covered with a receipt, the flat sum is only for mentors in Stockholm county. Send me the receipt within two weeks of the trip and I will sort the rest with Anders.

subject: Funder meeting minutes
body: Dear Karin, minutes of the meeting on the 19th are attached. Please check the action points in section four. Your name is next to the note on lessons from round one.

subject: Re: Funder meeting minutes
body: Minutes are correct. I will deliver the note on lessons after the second round, as discussed.

thread: Thank you and a note on the panel
subject: Thank you and a note on the panel
body: Dear Karin, I heard the panel was a success and that Lena did well. Thank you for letting me step back without fuss. If you ever need a speaker for an event in the autumn, I would be delighted.

subject: Invoice: Helsinki train and hotel (EUR)
body:
Hej Daniel,

The Helsinki day trip does not need a hotel after all, as you said. Invoice 8940 therefore covers only the flights. The amount is stated in SEK, but two of the airline's supplements are charged in EUR on the airline's side and appear on the invoice as EUR 62. They are explained in the notes.

Mia

subject: Re: Invoice: Helsinki train and hotel (EUR)
body: Thanks, Mia. I will pay the SEK total. Please have the airline's EUR supplement noted on the receipt so our auditors can see what it was.

thread: VAT return and a small adjustment
subject: VAT return and a small adjustment
body: Hej Anders, the VAT return for January and February is ready for your signature. I made one adjustment: the Tallinn hotel receipts carry foreign VAT that cannot be reclaimed, so I took it out of the Swedish return. The difference is small, 312 SEK. Details on page two.

thread: VAT return and a small adjustment
subject: Re: VAT return and a small adjustment
body: Signed and sent. Thank you for catching the hotel VAT, I would have missed it.

thread: Helsinki on the 13th: can I come?
subject: Helsinki on the 13th: can I come?
body: Nora, I live in Helsinki and am free on the 13th. I could meet Daniel and Karin at the Founders House and take part in the mentor sessions. It would save you from bringing a mentor from Stockholm.

thread: Helsinki on the 13th: can I come?
subject: Re: Helsinki on the 13th: can I come?
body: Yes please. Karin wanted two mentors there, one for fundraising and one for product. You are the product one. Ingrid will be the other. I will tell Juho.

subject: Helsinki 13 March: draft programme
body: Karin, here is a draft for the 13th. 10:30 coffee, 11:00 your talk, 12:00 lunch, 13:00 to 16:00 mentor sessions in small rooms, 16:30 closing round with the community. Do you want a Q&A after the talk or a roundtable?

subject: Re: Helsinki 13 March: draft programme
body: Q&A, please. A roundtable needs more preparation than I can promise. Otherwise your programme is perfect.

subject: Newsletter: March draft
body: Karin, March newsletter is in the folder. Lead: thank you to the demo day crowd. Then the grant writing session on the 12th, the Helsinki visit, and the mentor profile of Fredrik. I did not mention the interview stage, I assumed that is for a separate mail.

subject: Re: Newsletter: March draft
body: Right, interviews are for a separate mail. Send the newsletter on Tuesday.

subject: Demo day follow-up: panel notes
body: Daniel, my notes after the demo day panel. We were generous on the pitch sheet and a little harder on the substance sheet, which is the right way round. One more suggestion: next time, tell the panel on the day how heavily the audience vote will weigh against ours, because I had to guess. The weights were never explained and we ended up not using them at all.

subject: Re: Demo day follow-up: panel notes
body: Fair point. Next time we will write it on the run sheet. The audience vote was only a conversation starter this time, no prize was attached.

thread: Hamnkontoret: final invoice for demo day
subject: Hamnkontoret: final invoice for demo day
body: Hello Daniel, the final invoice for 26 February is attached: hall 9 500, stage riser included, cloakroom 4 900 for two people and fourteen hours, less the deposit of 3 000. Total to pay 11 400 SEK excluding VAT.

thread: Hamnkontoret: final invoice for demo day
subject: Fwd: Hamnkontoret: final invoice for demo day
body: Anders, final invoice from the venue. I checked it against the confirmation. All matches.

thread: Alumni office hours: a new idea
subject: Alumni office hours: a new idea
body:
Hello everyone,

We are testing something new this spring: a monthly evening where alumni can sit with a current mentor and ask questions about the stage after the programme. Think of it as the office hours you wish you had after demo day. The first one is on Thursday 2 April. Reply if you would like to come.

Tomas

thread: Alumni office hours: a new idea
subject: Re: Alumni office hours: a new idea
body: We would love to. Could we have a mentor who knows about export controls? We are about to ship hardware to a country we do not know much about.

subject: Mentor with export knowledge?
body: Nora, an alumnus is asking for a mentor who knows about export controls and hardware shipping. Anyone in your network?

subject: Re: Mentor with export knowledge?
body: Oskar did hardware for a long time, and he knows a customs broker personally. I will ask him if he is free on the 2nd.

thread: Round 2: what happens after you apply
subject: Round 2: what happens after you apply
body:
Hello,

For those of you wondering what comes next, here is the plain version. We read every application. Some companies are invited to an interview, and the invitation arrives by email with the details. Companies that are not invited also hear from us by email, with a short note. We will not be able to say more about individual applications before that.

If you notice a mistake in something you sent us, tell us at programme@fieldnote.example and say what it concerns.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Round 2: what happens after you apply
subject: Re: Round 2: what happens after you apply
body: Karin, the mail went out at 13:45 to the whole list. Two bounces and no replies yet. I have saved the text for the FAQ in case we want it there.

subject: Expense claim, February
body: Nora, my expense claim for the Uppsala train is attached. I know it is late, but I only found the receipts this morning.

subject: Re: Expense claim, February
body: Oskar, claims have to come within two weeks and yours was received after the deadline by three days. I will forward it to Anders and ask for an exception this once. Please do not let it become a habit.

subject: Re: Expense claim, February
body: Nora, I will approve Oskar's claim as an exception. For the record, my rule for the rest of the spring is: claims received after the deadline go in the next payment run, no exceptions without a note from you.

subject: Call page: favicon
body: Karin, the browser tab icon on the call page was the generic one because the file had a typo in its name. I fixed the name, and now the small orange note shows. Not content, just a file.

subject: Re: Call page: favicon
body: Good. People notice the small things before they read the text.

thread: Grant writing session on the 12th: coffee only?
subject: Grant writing session on the 12th: coffee only?
body: Hej Daniel, for the grant writing session I have you down for coffee, tea and sandwiches for 25. A late guest list adjustment is fine until 10:00 the same day. Tell me if the sandwich order should be vegetarian only.

thread: Grant writing session on the 12th: coffee only?
subject: Re: Grant writing session on the 12th: coffee only?
body: Half and half is fine. Twenty-five is right at the moment, but I would not be surprised if it becomes thirty.

thread: Withdrawn mentor for the thank-you evening
subject: Withdrawn mentor for the thank-you evening
body: Karin, a small change for the mentor thank-you evening: Henrik has withdrawn because he is flying to a conference. Seventeen mentors and staff are still coming. I told the restaurant that the number fell by one.

thread: Withdrawn mentor for the thank-you evening
subject: Re: Withdrawn mentor for the thank-you evening
body: Fine. Send Henrik a postcard, we have a stack from Tallinn. Maybe he will forgive us.

thread: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
subject: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
body: Hi Daniel, our check list says two long HDMI cables did not come back after demo day. They might still be at Hamnkontoret. If they do not turn up we have to charge 240 SEK as an adjustment on the final invoice.

thread: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
subject: Re: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
body: I will ask Lars to look under the stage. I have a feeling they are in the cloakroom basket.

thread: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
subject: Re: AV equipment returned: two cables missing
body: Daniel, found them in the basket, as you said. I will keep them at reception. Please send someone before Friday.

subject: Next funder newsletter
body: Dear Karin, our newsletter goes out in April. Could we use two sentences and a photo from the demo day? We would be glad to credit your photographer.

thread: Grant writing session: a speaker has withdrawn
subject: Grant writing session: a speaker has withdrawn
body: Karin, bad luck. The grant adviser who was to lead the session tonight has withdrawn, she has the flu. Her colleague can talk for 30 minutes but cannot run the workshop. I suggest we run it as an open clinic, where founders bring their drafts.

thread: Grant writing session: a speaker has withdrawn
subject: Re: Grant writing session: a speaker has withdrawn
body: Open clinic is a good rescue. Tell the guests by email and let Elin know the food stays the same.

thread: Invoice for the black and white set
subject: Invoice for the black and white set
body: Hi Tomas, the black and white portraits are on the mentor pages. My invoice, 1 400 SEK plus VAT, is attached. Payment within 30 days.

thread: Interview panel: who is available on the days
subject: Interview panel: who is available on the days
body: Karin, the interview days are Thursday and Friday of the last week of March. I heard from Astrid, Ingrid and Henrik. Fredrik and Oskar are away on the Friday. I would like to know if you want a funder representative on the panel as well.

thread: Interview panel: who is available on the days
subject: Re: Interview panel: who is available on the days
body: No funder on the panel, they would rather not. I want three panellists in each room and a fourth person as timekeeper. Please draft a briefing paper for the panel with practical details only.

thread: Thank you and a small request
subject: Thank you and a small request
body: Nora, the positioning template has been downloaded by half the cohort. May I put a link to it in my mentor profile? And could the website say my sessions are mostly in Swedish?

thread: Thank you and a small request
subject: Re: Thank you and a small request
body: Link is fine, Sofia will add it. Languages we will say on the page, yes. I will write to Sofia now.

subject: Co-hosted demo evening: first outline
body: Karin, as promised we wrote up an outline for the autumn demo evening in Tallinn. It has your format, ours, and a shared registration page. We think two cohorts, Tallinn and Stockholm, with one hour for each. Do you want to look before we speak to our board?

subject: Re: Co-hosted demo evening: first outline
body: I will read it at the weekend and write on Monday. Your board should hear it first from us, so thank you for waiting.

subject: Flight in an hour
body: Daniel, I am at the gate. If there is a problem, the train to Helsinki station is a 30 minute taxi from the airport. I have the programme and a printed copy of the talk, just in case the projector fails.

subject: Helsinki: short note
body: The talk went fine, the Q&A was better than the talk. About 70 founders came. Juho's community is a friendly one. We got four ideas for the autumn event and two offers of sponsored lunch. Thank you to Joonas and Ingrid for running the sessions.

thread: Call page: alt text on images
subject: Call page: alt text on images
body: Daniel, a screen reader test showed that two images on the call page had no description. I added short alt text to both. No visible change.

thread: Call page: alt text on images
subject: Re: Call page: alt text on images
body: Good. I forgot the second one existed.

thread: Autumn trip to Tallinn: early options
subject: Autumn trip to Tallinn: early options
body: Hej Daniel, I know it is early, but fares to Tallinn for the autumn event are cheapest if booked before April. I can hold six seats at the current price for ten days without commitment. Tell me if you want me to.

thread: Autumn trip to Tallinn: early options
subject: Re: Autumn trip to Tallinn: early options
body: Yes, hold six. We do not know the date, so please ask for a flexible ticket that can move by plus or minus a week.

thread: Venue deposits and the budget line
subject: Venue deposits and the budget line
body: Daniel, the venue deposits for the autumn event are not in this half-year's budget. Please do not sign anything for the Tallinn demo evening until we have a budget line for it.

subject: Thank-you evening: your plus one
body: Hi Astrid, the restaurant asks whether your plus one eats fish. They are building the menu now and the kitchen likes to know on Wednesday.

subject: Re: Thank-you evening: your plus one
body: Fish yes, mushrooms no. He claims to be allergic to mushrooms, but I think he just does not like them.

subject: Call page: print stylesheet
body: Hi all, I added a print stylesheet so the call page prints on one A4 sheet without the navigation bar. Please ignore if you never print web pages, which I understand.

subject: Re: Call page: print stylesheet
body: I print everything, so thank you. Is the footer on the print version supposed to say "Questions? Write to us"?

subject: Re: Call page: print stylesheet
body: Yes, it is the same footer as on the screen.

thread: Round 2: interview logistics, accessibility and arrival
subject: Round 2: interview logistics, accessibility and arrival
body:
Hello,

Some practical notes for the interview days, so that nobody has to ask the same question twice. The interviews are held at an office near Slussen, five minutes from the metro. Please arrive about ten minutes before your time and ask for the Fieldnote programme at reception. If you need step-free access, an interpreter or a quiet room, tell us in your reply to the invitation. We will confirm each request in writing.

This note is for everyone on the list. It does not mean you have been invited.

The Fieldnote programme team

thread: Round 2: interview logistics, accessibility and arrival
subject: Re: Round 2: interview logistics, accessibility and arrival
body: Karin, the mail went at 11:30. I cleared the rooms with Lars and agreed that Room A and Room B are held from 08:30 on both days. The café opens for us at 07:30 so lunch is not an issue.

subject: A conflict I should declare
body: Karin, I will not be on any interview panel, but if you are looking for people to talk to later, note that my fund has a prior relationship with a company that applied. I will not discuss it with anyone on the team. Just so it is on the record.

subject: Re: A conflict I should declare
body: Thank you, Pontus. Noted, and no one on the team will ask you about it.

thread: Interview days: panel briefing at 14:00 on Wednesday 25 March
subject: Interview days: panel briefing at 14:00 on Wednesday 25 March
body: Please block Wednesday 25 March, 14:00, for the briefing. We will go through the running order of the interview days, how to take notes, how to give each team the same amount of time, and what to do if a candidate is upset. The panel receives its material the day before.

thread: Interview day: what do I need to prepare?
subject: Interview day: what do I need to prepare?
body: Daniel, do I need to read anything before the interview days? In a previous programme the secretariat sent a full folder two weeks ahead. I prefer to know early.

thread: Interview day: what do I need to prepare?
subject: Re: Interview day: what do I need to prepare?
body: Henrik, you will get the material the day before, as Karin said. Nothing long, I promise. If you want to read about the programme itself, the mentor guide and the website are good enough.

subject: March invoice: Ekonomibyrån
body: Hej Anders, March bookkeeping invoice 2025-1301 is ready. 4 250 SEK plus VAT as usual, and a fee adjustment of 400 SEK because we needed to redo the quarter's reconciliation. I am sorry for the inconvenience, but the extra hours were real.

subject: Re: March invoice: Ekonomibyrån
body: That is a surprise. Please send me the hours so I can explain it to the board. I accept in principle, I just want the note for the auditors.

subject: Tallinn board meets on the 10th
body: Karin, our board will see your autumn outline on 10 April. If they like it, we can announce the event in May. Would you prefer to send a short introduction yourself?

subject: Re: Tallinn board meets on the 10th
body: Yes, I will write three paragraphs and send them on Friday. Thank you for guiding us through your process.

subject: Mentor guide: small changes
body: Dear mentors, I updated the mentor guide with a paragraph about video sessions and one on how to send follow-up notes after a session. Please read it, it is short. The only change in your commitments is that we ask for the follow-up note on the same day when you can.

subject: Re: Mentor guide: small changes
body: Nora, thank you. A suggestion: could the guide include a template for the follow-up note? A few of my notes were long and did not help.

subject: Re: Mentor guide: small changes
body: Yes. Three bullet points is already what the guide asks for, but a template makes it easier to follow. I will draft one and send it for comment.

subject: Alumni newsletter: autumn issue ideas
body: Karin, a first list for the autumn alumni newsletter: stories of cohorts reuniting, a section on hiring across borders, the Tallinn demo evening if it happens. Which do you want most?

subject: Re: Alumni newsletter: autumn issue ideas
body: The hiring section. Everyone I meet is hiring and nobody finds the right people.

subject: Invoice 4529 and a compliment
body: Hi Sofia, invoice 4529 is attached, 1 980 SEK including VAT for the interview-day signs. Your file was perfect, and on time, so I can only compliment you. This time nothing arrived late at all.

subject: Re: Invoice 4529 and a compliment
body: Thank you. I measured the signs three times, and I now live in fear of the day I get it wrong.

thread: Invoice: AV, final (EUR line for the Finnish camera)
subject: Invoice: AV, final (EUR line for the Finnish camera)
body: Hi Daniel, the final invoice for the demo day is attached. The livestream camera was a rental from our Helsinki partner and that line is shown in EUR. The rest is in SEK as quoted. I have also listed the cable adjustment we discussed, minus the two cables found.

thread: Invoice: AV, final (EUR line for the Finnish camera)
subject: Re: Invoice: AV, final (EUR line for the Finnish camera)
body: Thank you. I will pay the SEK part now and the EUR line in the next batch from the EUR account.

thread: Round 2: coffee and water for the interview rooms
subject: Round 2: coffee and water for the interview rooms
body: Hello Lars, a small request. Please place a jug of water and six glasses in each interview room and a coffee thermos in the waiting area. We will bring name cards for the panel ourselves. Please also tell us how early the doors open on the morning.

thread: Round 2: coffee and water for the interview rooms
subject: Re: Round 2: coffee and water for the interview rooms
body: Doors open at 07:30. Water and glasses are no problem, thermos from the café. I will put it on the invoice as a single line.

subject: Newsletter: April lead
body: Karin, for the April newsletter, I propose a lead about the mentor thank-you evening and a first look at the autumn cohort programme. Do you want to keep the interview stage out of it?

subject: Re: Newsletter: April lead
body: Keep interviews out. The mentor evening is good. For the autumn programme just say that details will follow.

thread: Portrait session for the interview panel?
subject: Portrait session for the interview panel?
body: Tomas, would you like a picture of the interview panel for the website? A fifteen minute session on Wednesday afternoon works for me. No obligations.

thread: Portrait session for the interview panel?
subject: Re: Portrait session for the interview panel?
body: Let us wait until the autumn. The panel is not final and I would prefer to see them smiling after the interviews, not before.

subject: Judging panel scoring sheet: draft
body: Karin, the draft of the scoring sheet for the interview days is in the folder. It has space for notes and a short free-text line per candidate, and no boxes for numbers, because you asked for notes only. Is that what you meant?

subject: Re: Judging panel scoring sheet: draft
body: Yes. The sheet is for notes only. The panel's notes help the conversation afterwards, they are not a second score. Please do not add any boxes for weights or points, I would hate them to be misread as such.

thread: Weights, the gym and the mentor evening
subject: Weights, the gym and the mentor evening
body: Daniel, a funny one. The restaurant for the thank-you evening shares a building with a gym and asked if we could not drop any free weights in the lobby for the evening, they are clearing space. I said sure, someone will carry them to the stairs.

thread: Weights, the gym and the mentor evening
subject: Re: Weights, the gym and the mentor evening
body: I volunteer. It is the only workout I will get this week.

thread: Photo credits for the funder newsletter
subject: Photo credits for the funder newsletter
body: Dear Karin, we confirm we will credit Hanna Ek. Could she send three images at 1600 pixels wide? Our editor wants a choice.

thread: Photo credits for the funder newsletter
subject: Fwd: Photo credits for the funder newsletter
body: Hanna, the funder group would like three images from demo day at 1600 pixels wide, with your credit. Please send them to Berit directly and put me on copy.

subject: Half-year budget: the last numbers
body: Karin, I closed the half-year numbers early so you have them for the interview days. We are 2 percent under on cost per startup, travel is at 91 percent and I would like to keep it there. Nothing else to flag.

thread: Helsinki follow-up: two founders want sessions
subject: Helsinki follow-up: two founders want sessions
body: Nora, after Friday's day at the Founders House two founders asked for a session with me. They are not in the programme. What is our policy?

thread: Helsinki follow-up: two founders want sessions
subject: Re: Helsinki follow-up: two founders want sessions
body: Be friendly and give them half an hour of your own time if you like. We do not book mentors for non-participants, but a one-off coffee is your call.

subject: Reminder about tomorrow
body:
Karin, the ranking job is set for tomorrow morning. I looked at the status of the runner this morning and it is idle and healthy. I have not changed anything on it this week.

The part-time engineer

subject: Interview days: last checks
body: Daniel, last checks. Panels set, rooms confirmed, signs delivered, catering ordered. The only gap is the printed directions for the invitations, are they ready?

subject: Re: Interview days: last checks
body: Printed directions are at reception and a PDF is attached to the invitation template. Nothing else open on my list.

thread: Interview days: sandwiches and a thank-you
subject: Interview days: sandwiches and a thank-you
body: Hej Daniel, for the two interview days I will deliver sandwiches and fruit at 12:00 for the panel and the staff. I put the price in the attached sheet. A last-minute adjustment of two people is no problem, just send me a message by 09:00.

subject: Lift service report
body: Dear Fieldnote, the lift at Slussen has been repaired and passed inspection. The report is attached. Thank you for your patience during the work.

subject: Programme feedback: Nordic Startup Days
body: Dear Karin, thank you for your session on 5 March. We have received participants' evaluations and your talk was among the three highest rated. We would be happy to invite you again next year. Please reply by 1 April if you would like a slot.

subject: Re: Programme feedback: Nordic Startup Days
body: Thank you, I will reply next week. Please pass on my thanks to the evaluators.

subject: Website: monthly report
body: Hi all, the web numbers for March. Visits are up slightly, the FAQ is still the second most read page, and the most common search is "mentors". Two broken links remain on the events archive. I am on it.
